description: This file manages volume permissions and ownership for Linux in Kubernetes, including changing file permissions, ownership, and recursive directory traversal.

classes.name: VolumeOwnership
classes.description: Handles recursive permission and ownership changes for volumes, including progress monitoring.

methods.name: AddProgressNotifier
methods.description: Adds a progress notifier with pod and recorder references.

methods.name: ChangePermissions
methods.description: Initiates recursive permission change if fsGroup is set.

methods.name: initiateProgressMonitor
methods.description: Starts progress monitoring for volume ownership setting.

methods.name: changePermissionsRecursively
methods.description: Recursively walks directory to change permissions.

methods.name: monitorProgress
methods.description: Logs progress and warnings during permission setting.

methods.name: logWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning about ongoing permission change.
